cp19:1.1: Pañcālaraṭṭhe nagaravare Kapilāyaṃ pur' uttame rājā Jayaddiso nāma sīlaguṇa-m-upāgato. || ||
cp19:2.1: Tassa rañño ahaṃ putto sutadhammo susīlavā Alīnasatto guṇavā anurattaparijano sadā. || ||
cp19:3.1: Pitā me migavaṃ gantvā porisādaṃ upāgami so me pitum-aggahesi: bhakkho 'si mama mā cali. || ||
cp19:4.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā bhīto tasitavedhito ūrukkhambho ahu tassa disvāna porisādakaṃ. || ||
cp19:5.1: Migavaṃ gahetvā muñcassu katvā āgamanaṃ puna brāhmaṇassa dhanaṃ datvā pitā āmantayī mamaṃ: || ||
cp19:6.1: Rajjaṃ putta paṭipajja mā pamajji puraṃ idaṃ kataṃ me porisādena mama āgamanaṃ puna. || ||
cp19:7.1: Mātā pitu ca vanditvā nimminitvāna attānaṃ nikkhipitvā dhanuṃ khaggaṃ porisādaṃ upāgamiṃ. || ||
cp19:8.1: Sasatthahatth' ūpagataṃ kadāci so tasissati tena bhijjissati sīlaṃ paritāsaṃ kate mayi. || ||
cp19:9.1: Sīlakkhaṇḍabhayā mayhaṃ tassa dessaṃ na vyāhariṃ mettacitto hitavādī idaṃ vacanam-abraviṃ: || ||
cp19:10.1: Ujjālehi mahā-aggiṃ papatissāmi rukkhato tvaṃ pakkakālam-aññāya bhakkhaya maṃ pitāmaha. || ||
cp19:11.1: Iti sīlavataṃ hetu nārakkhiṃ mama jīvitaṃ pabbājesiṃ c' ahaṃ tassa sadā pāṇātipātikan-ti. || ||
